horoscope: A pleasant aspect between Mars and Uranus today supports you energetically, dear Aries, and it's strong for enterprising activities. You're in particularly great shape for creative learning, personal interests, romantic expression, and satisfying entertainment. You can take a hobby, project, game, or even a relationship to a new level. You may be itching to take action, and rewards come from activities that engage your heart or inspire you. In fact, the more inspired you feel, the better the results. Your powers of communication today heighten your magnetism, especially as you're willing to move on and forward. Still, the Moon spends the day in your work and health sector, and you're also quite focused on taking care of practical problems.

With today's Mars-Uranus transit, dear Taurus, you’re in great shape to discover new ways to improve your practical affairs. It brings out your resourcefulness, and you may be finding new ways to make good use of your talents, time, energy, and money. What excites you most right now is making improvements and seeing progress. New ways of relating to family or presenting yourself to others can yield surprisingly good results today and this week. Your life demands outside-of-the-box thinking and acting. Organization around the home or work environment can help move things along. You’re willing to put a lot of effort into making things more secure, comfortable, and efficient. With this transit, the need to take action — to step in — can be intense. You’re also quite willing to focus on things that may need changing on the inside, not just the outside.

You’re feeling inspired right now, dear Gemini, particularly regarding new ventures or enterprises related to communications, ideas, learning, and teaching or guiding. You want to get things done and add your unique style to what you’re doing with Mars in harmony with Uranus in your sign. You’re enthusiastic and will put special energy, effort, and time into learning endeavors and relationships. You’re motivated to pursue a learning or mental challenge, and your pioneering, progressive ideas will likely be winners now. Even with the Moon in your sector of comfort and familiarity, it’s a fine day to put an inhibition related to expressing yourself behind you.

Today's transits position you well for putting a project that’s been limiting you or a bad habit behind you, dear Cancer. You feel emotionally equipped not only to accept but embrace change and progress courtesy of this liberating aspect. Money matters, special care of personal possessions or valuables, and ownership issues can be in focus--and they're in good favor. Unique and fresh business or money management approaches emerge, or you learn something new about the past that helps you move forward. The best thing you can do for yourself now is to aim to detach from or let go of a problem that has been frustrating you. The Moon spends all day in your solar third house, and you're drawn to those things that engage your mind and activate your curiosity.

With Mars in your sign connecting harmoniously with Uranus today, dear Leo, making friends, expanding your group, or enhancing relationships with associates can be in order. Instead, you might gain some forward momentum and motivation from long-term projects that invigorate and excite you. The desire to step in or take corrective or progressive action is pleasantly intense today and this week. You seem to be at the heart of the innovative energy of the day. Others seem to respond positively to you, putting you in great shape for networking, shared activities, and communications. Personal opportunities can come through group activities or friends (or even friends of friends), who are finding you particularly impressive.

The Moon in your sign adds emotional color to your life all day, dear Virgo, and a Mars-Uranus transit enlivens things further. Extra effort behind the scenes can pay off today and this week, in fact. The key now is to draw upon your inventive side while also showing your dedication and loyalty. There can be a sudden need to put a long-standing problem behind you or deal with a secret weighing you down, and you seem up to the task. You’re highly motivated to free yourself, so take advantage! Sometimes you need a little extra push, and today’s Mars-Uranus transit may well be it. Support could come in from an unexpected source, or you may surprise yourself with your inner strength and courage after a period of self-questioning. Your practical world benefits greatly from your intuition and experience. Resources might reveal themselves, or you’re able to detach yourself from a matter just enough to handle it quickly and move forward.

Today’s Mars-Uranus transit energizes and inspires you, dear Libra, and you can feel enthusiastic and excited about a fresh start. You’re in great shape for an adventure, whether big or small, sharing ideas, learning something exciting, or connecting with people who inspire and excite you. Romantic opportunities or meeting friends can be in focus and more likely to happen through non-routine activities. If you’re teaching, guiding, or otherwise influencing and inspiring others, your enthusiastic presentation invites people to follow your lead, making it a great time for networking, promotion, or otherwise spreading the word. Today is strong for feeling engaged and empowered.

You can enjoy a strong desire to pioneer or innovate today, dear Scorpio, and you may enjoy coming up with new ventures or methods to improve what you already have going. You're likely to be ahead of the competition if you're even noticing them at all. This can be a time for turning a limiting situation that has weighed you down in the past into a powerful motivator for new goals and ambitions. A new attitude can be the first step toward increased freedom. Business matters can certainly benefit from your attention and confidence right now. It's important to feel the inspiration for what you're doing, because if you have that, you can move mountains. Things seem to be coming together naturally, and possibly more quickly than you imagined with Mars and Uranus in harmony today.

While the Moon spends the day in your responsible solar tenth house, dear Sagittarius, you’re naturally drawn to explore, discover, and enjoy the world around you today, or perhaps a close relationship. Encounters can be unusual or surprising, or a significant person in your life adds a healthy dose of excitement to your experience. A sense of progress, improvement, or growth is a powerful motivator with a harmonious aspect between Mars and Uranus in play. Promotional, educational, or legal affairs can thrive. News or learning experiences inspire you, or you may make satisfying progress with a travel or publishing matter. Common goals and philosophies are apparent now and can help cement a bond. Even if they're not shared, it's a fine time to open up to others' perspectives and share your own, perhaps inspiring someone. Maintaining your independence while also relating well feels right and comes naturally today.

You might learn something about someone from your past, or a conversation with a friend can quickly turn to the past today, dear Capricorn. With today's Mercury-Venus alignment, as Venus is retrograde, you tend to live in the mind rather than dig deep. This process can be useful to an extent, but do watch for talking ahead of yourself, as your heart may not be ready to talk or know about everything that piques your mind's curiosity! Today's transits can stir up a desire to make sense of certain feelings or relationships, but you may not have the whole story. Take a fresh route to express yourself and interact with others by reviewing matters rather than rehashing them. It's a good time for considering whether you're getting enough pleasure from your social life or current goals and projects.

Someone close to you can motivate you to pursue your heart’s desire today and this week, dear Aquarius, as Mars in your partnership sector harmonizes with Uranus in your house of creativity and joy. You’re in great shape to connect with others in unique, inspiring ways. Your appeal and magnetism are through the roof! A great time for spontaneous discovery, creative self-expression, and romantic exploration, you are drawn to uplifting, forward-looking experiences. Someone might propose something fun or encourage your creative side. You’re working and playing well with others! Channeling your energy into special causes or projects can be productive. With this influence, the focus may be on eliminating what weighs you down.

Today’s Mars-Uranus harmony most supports projects and endeavors related to home and work, dear Pisces. Innovative and inventive approaches work best under this influence. In fact, you’re more likely to get the results you want if you embrace change, even if what you’re working so hard for is about making life more secure! Today is excellent for attention to your house, job, routine, health, and self-care programs as you’re putting a new spin on these things, and your confidence is a big part of this. A different or even unusual approach can solve a problem, and it can be a huge relief. It's a time for a new attitude or mission to live more confidently and positively.
